observations: Motive describes the Ishimura as fully interconnected and traversable without camera cuts or load screens except death.
Completed locations can be revisited for missed items, new navigation paths, and new challenges.
The Intensity Director monitors room-to-room intensity and layers audio, lighting, fog, steam, and enemy events from a large event set.
inferences: A continuous spatial model makes revisitation and environmental memory reinforce each other.
Exploration tension needs pressure and release variation; constant threat becomes predictable noise rather than sustained fear.
limits: Developer features describe implementation intent but do not expose the complete pacing algorithm.
Atmosphere and fear remain player-dependent and require direct playtesting.
